quotes.author: Chris Church
quotes.title: Fixes for WinRM/PowerShell support in v2.

quotes.text:
- Add support for inserting module args into PowerShell modules.  Fixes #11661.
- Support Windows paths containing spaces.  Applies changes from #10727 to v2.  Fixes #9999.  Should also fix ansible/ansible-modules-core#944 and ansible/ansible-modules-core#1007.
- Change how execution policy is set for running remote scripts.
quotes.author: Chris Church
quotes.title: Fixes for WinRM/PowerShell support in v2.

quotes.text:
Applies changes from #11092 to v2.  Also fixes ansible/ansible-modules-core#1776.
- Use codepage 65001 (UTF-8) for WinRM connection instead of default (CP437), convert command to UTF-8 and results from UTF-8.  Replaces changes from #10024.  Fixes #11198.
- Close WinRM connection when task completes.

medium: These passages detail the necessity of closing the WinRM connection to address compatibility issues with PowerShell, Windows paths, and encoding conversions.

case.deletion_subject: remove closing connections after every task, this goes against conneciton caching and was not expected behaviuor nor inhertited from v1

revert_subject: Revert "remove closing connections after every task, this goes against conneciton caching and was not expected behaviuor nor inhertited from v1" needed for winrm, disabled closing connections in ssh to avoid issues with that persistance, need to normalize all this in future

card.what: This line closes the WinRM connection established for the current task, releasing resources.
card.why: The quotes below are the closest the history comes; they do not state a reason outright.
card.next: Before making any changes, verify that closing the connection at the task level is the correct approach for resource management and doesn't introduce unintended consequences for subsequent tasks.

answer: Closing the connection after every task is needed for winrm.
